messages.content: Can you reconcile the Raleigh trip now? I want the reissued ticket checked, the hotel updated, and one corrected itinerary in time order.

I’m seeing one important correction: the active reissue is the no-cost Wednesday connection through Detroit, landing at RDU at 10:42 p.m. The Friday nonstop is still ticketed for 5:35–7:48 p.m. The 11:08 p.m. nonstop and its $146 increase are not on the current ticket.
Good catch. Please use the ticket that is actually active and remove the other flight from the trip record.

Done. The expense record now reflects the reissued Detroit itinerary with no additional airfare collected. The canceled original outbound and the unissued 11:08 p.m. option have been removed. Airfare is back to $584; the hotel remains $521, so paid reservations total $1,105.
Does the Friday flight have the same confirmation and times?
Yes. The Friday, September 1 RDU–MSP nonstop remains on the same ticket record and is unchanged at 5:35–7:48 p.m.
Update the hotel’s arrival note with the actual flight. What time should I expect to reach it?

The hotel record now lists the reissued flight number and 10:42 p.m. arrival. Allowing about 15 minutes to deplane and reach the pickup area, a short rideshare wait, and roughly 20–25 minutes to the Cary hotel, expected check-in is about 11:25–11:40 p.m. The 24-hour desk and room hold remain noted.
Finish with the clean chronology, and keep ground transportation separate from what is paid.

Corrected itinerary: Wednesday, August 30, depart MSP on the reissued itinerary and connect in Detroit; arrive RDU at 10:42 p.m. Take a rideshare to the Cary hotel, with check-in expected around 11:25–11:40 p.m. Stay Wednesday and Thursday nights. Friday, September 1, check out by noon, attend the client office, then rideshare to RDU for the unchanged nonstop departing 5:35 p.m. and arriving MSP at 7:48 p.m. Confirmed paid total is $1,105: $584 airfare and $521 lodging. Rideshares remain unpaid estimates and are excluded from that total.
